EC-Council HackAI Challenge @ RACEx360 – Securing the AI-Powered Enterprise

Think you can hack AI? Put your cybersecurity skills to the test at the EC-Council HackAI Challenge @ RACEx360, a hands-on competitive security challenge focused on securing the AI-powered enterprise.

Designed for ethical hackers, red-teamers, penetration testers, AppSec professionals, bug-bounty hunters, AI-security practitioners, CTF players, security researchers and exceptional students, the challenge brings real-world AI security scenarios into a competitive environment.

Participants will tackle challenges across areas such as Prompt Injection, LLM Jailbreaking, RAG Poisoning, AI OSINT, NL2SQL Injection, Training Data Poisoning, Adversarial Attacks, AI Supply Chain Security and Agentic AI Privilege Escalation.

How it works:

  • Individual Registration: ₹2,000 per participant
  • Online Qualifier: 10–18 September 2026
  • Challenge Duration: One 90-minute attempt per participant
  • Top Performers: Advance to the Grand Finale
  • Grand Finale: 25 September 2026 at RACEx360, Taj West End, Bengaluru
  • Grand Finale Duration: 2 hours

This is more than a competition—it's an opportunity to prove your hands-on AI security capabilities, compete with strong offensive security talent, earn leaderboard recognition, and reach the RACEx360 Grand Finale.

  • Theme: Securing the AI-Powered Enterprise
  • Red Team. Defend. Secure.
  • Registration closes: 10 September 2026
  • Finale: 25 September 2026 | RACEx360 | Taj West End, Bengaluru

Explore the Event:
